inlines.v: BREAKER, noun The person who breaks any thing; a violator or transgressor; as a breaker of the law. 1. A rock which breaks the waves; or the wave itself which breaks the waves; or the wave itself which breaks against a rock, a sand bank, or the shore, exhibiting a white foam. 2. A pier, mound or other solid matter, placed in a river, to break the floating ice, and prevent it from injuring a bridge below; called also ice-breaker. 3. One that breaks up ground. 4. A destroyer. Micah 2:13.
